headline: aespa joins Disney's U.S. holiday special on ABC
sub: The group performs 'Santa Baby' from Disney's Magic Kingdom

info.title: How to watch
rows: 'The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular'

caption:
aespa is bringing the holiday spirit to American TV! 🎄

aespa will appear on 'The Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular,' ABC's annual Christmas special now in its 11th year. The group taped their performance at Walt Disney World's Magic Kingdom, singing the holiday classic 'Santa Baby' and more. The special airs Monday, Nov 30 on ABC in the U.S.

📌 Source: Yonhap News (via Korean media), ABC
